parts.problem_md:
The Sous reservoir in the Czech Republic is a source of drinking water for 100000 people in the region.

The area has been affected by acid deposition.

(i) Define acid deposition.

[1]

(ii) Outline the formation of acid deposition from sulfur compounds.

[3]

(iii) Describe strategies for reducing the emissions of gases that cause acid deposition.

[3]
